C1.text: Audit prevalence of speaker-nonexclusivity risk (Y_any primary, Y_test secondary) in a frozen-rule probability sample of public SER repository lineages
C1.verdict_rule: always reported with intervals; no verdict

C2-rep.text: Same-implementation replication of the RAVDESS/CREMA-D direction (Ibrahim et al. 2026; Zielonka et al. 2022; our 2026 P1)
C2-rep.verdict_rule: supported iff all eight reject; per-test verdicts in evidence; not a headline claim

C2a.text: Speaker-nonexclusive splitting inflates UAR on the repetition-clean SUBESCO-980 panel (scratch and probes)
C2a.verdict_rule: supported iff N01 rejects; N02 reported

C2b.text: The premium decomposes into positive outer test leakage and positive inner selection leakage on SUBESCO-980

C3a.text: Prompt/content overlap alone inflates UAR at speaker-exclusive training
C3a.verdict_rule: supported iff >=1 rejects and no opposite-sign rejection

C3b.text: Cross-prompt speaker overlap alone inflates UAR at prompt-exclusive training
C3b.verdict_rule: supported iff >=1 rejects and no opposite-sign rejection

C3c.text: Sibling takes add a further increment at matched N

C3d.text: At matched N, fewer speakers with higher per-speaker density inflate more

C4a.text: The premium persists under partial fine-tuning of WavLM-base+

C4b.text: Fine-tuning re-exposes speaker information relative to the frozen same-regime comparator
C4b.verdict_rule: estimation claim after a priori demotion: reported with intervals; no verdict

S1.text: Supplement: hyperparameter selection on a speaker-overlapping validation set is optimistic

S2.text: Supplement: the frozen-probe outer-boundary premium is head-dependent

S3.text: Supplement: LOSO advantage equals a training-set-size effect on CREMA-D frozen features
S3.verdict_rule: supported iff TOST rejects both one-sided nulls

S4.text: Supplement: no spillover to unexposed co-fold speakers
S4.verdict_rule: supported iff TOST rejects both one-sided nulls

audit: Y_any and Y_test proportions, Wilson and partial-identification intervals, hypergeometric frame envelope, U bounds, execution-eligible fraction, realized overlap on the eligible subset, kappa with CI
accuracy and macro-F1 released without inference
family_policy: Families are claim-wise: one Holm family per headline claim group; FWER 0.05 within each family; no program-wise error rate is claimed. Only hypotheses with a_priori_status == 'confirmatory' enter a family; hypotheses demoted a priori by the simulated power table (power_holm < 0.5) are reported as estimates with CIs.
forbidden_claims: prevalence x effect multiplication or a universal correction factor
'more than half' or any threshold statement about the audit
